summary: An excerpt from a fiction work (Book 10, part 12) following Zbigkrot, a productive member of a monastic Order, and Lawrence, who observes him. It covers Zbigkrot's 20 percent time projects, his performance ranking, and his gardening, then turns to a Securitat data stream he tagged with 68 bytes, which Lawrence suspects is purchase data screened for bomb-ingredient patterns. Lawrence searches for Zbigkrot's sister Anja Krotoski, whose New York apartment on 23d Street is now run down, and watches residents shift from hard city faces to relaxed selves once they enter their building.
one_line: Excerpt from a fiction book where monk Zbigkrot's routine data work and a missing sister in New York are observed by Lawrence.
key_facts: Zbigkrot spent his 20 percent time building aerial photography rigs out of box-kites and tiny cameras.
The tiny cameras were installed on the Monks' systems to help them monitor their body mechanics and ergonomic posture.
Zbigkrot performed in the eighty-fifth percentile of the Order.
Lawrence had performed between 70 and 88 percentile over time, depending on how he was doing in the rest of his life.
Zbigkrot maintained big gardens for produce and a small allotment garden for baroque cross-breeding experiments.
Lawrence thought the Securitat stream was probably purchase data from hardware and grocery stores, inspected for patterns that might indicate bomb ingredient buying.
Zbigkrot had worked on this kind of data thousands of times before, six times that day.
Zbigkrot added sixty-eight bytes to the Securitat stream and then left.
Zbigkrot once had a sister in New York named Anja Krotoski.
Anja Krotoski had lived on 23d Street in a co-op near Lexington, but her numbers all rang dead.
The apartment building once had a red awning and a doorman's niche, but the doorman was long gone and one lobby pane was replaced with cardboard.
Lawrence compared the neglected City buildings to buildings he had seen in Belgrade, where he briefed a gang of outsource programmers his boss had hired.
Residents' faces changed from hard city-dweller masks to relaxed people once the building door closed behind them.
Lawrence remembered a feeling from his earlier life of having two faces.
